card.name: Ends of drug names in interaction lines
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug name right after 'with' in co-administration or interaction statements, such as alfuzosin, rivaroxaban, thalidomide or atorvastatin calcium. It also fires weakly on a few other name endings like 'European Space Agency'.

modes.label: Drug name endings
modes.description: Final piece of a drug name that is the object of co-administration with another drug.
